title: Quaint Dense German Cheese Curds Toast
description: A traditional German dish featuring dense cheese curds on toasted bread, perfect for a romantic snack. This recipe is gluten-free friendly.

ingredients.name: gluten-free bread
ingredients.notes: dense bread, such as rye or pumpernickel

instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Butter each slice of bread on both sides.
Place the bread slices on a baking sheet and toast in the oven for 5 minutes.
While the bread is toasting, slice the cheese curds into 1/2 inch pieces.
Remove the bread from the oven and top each slice with a few pieces of cheese curds.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Return the bread to the oven and bake for an additional 5 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and the bread is crispy.
Remove from the oven and sprinkle with chopped parsley if desired.
